timingBoundaries.totalIssuanceMs: START: issueCertificate() invoked. END: issueCertificate() returns the Certificate. Excludes the fire-and-forget Supabase insert (measured separately as supabasePersistenceMs).
timingBoundaries.ipfsUploadMs: uploadToIPFS() — real server-function chain in-process: FormData validation + Pinata pin + CID return (browser→server HTTP RPC hop absent).
timingBoundaries.blockchainPreparationMs: getSigner() + getContract(signer) — wallet/signer and contract wiring.
timingBoundaries.blockchainSubmissionMs: registerCertificate(...) call until the transaction response/hash is returned (includes ethers' propagation poll until the node can serve the transaction).
timingBoundaries.blockchainConfirmationMs: waitForTransactionConfirmation() — tx.wait() raced against the application's 60s confirmation timeout, with one final receipt check on timeout. Resolves only from a real mined receipt; a timeout with no receipt is recorded as a FAILED run (category confirmation_pending) — never as success.
timingBoundaries.supabasePersistenceMs: saveCertificateToSupabase() insert; fire-and-forget in the real app, awaited only by the harness.

notes: All runs are REAL Polygon Amoy testnet transactions paid in test POL. No mainnet activity.
Signer: DEPLOYER_PRIVATE_KEY through an EIP-1193 shim (no MetaMask popup). Private key never logged or stored.
QR generation is render-time (CertificatePreview) and not part of issuance; measured once as a separate microbenchmark.
stdDev is the sample standard deviation (n-1).

microbenchmarks.note: Single run of QRCode.toDataURL (same options as CertificatePreview). Not part of the issuance pipeline.
